parameters.text:
=Analyze this inventory situation and provide reorder recommendations.

Low Stock Items (critical):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.low_stock) }}

Reorder Soon Items:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.reorder_soon) }}

Reorder lead time: {{ $('Set Store Config').item.json.reorder_lead_days }} days

For each item provide:
1. Recommended reorder quantity (based on 30-day velocity × 2 months supply)
2. Priority level
3. Estimated stockout date

Return JSON:
{
  "critical_items": [{"name": "", "current_stock": 0, "reorder_qty": 0, "stockout_in_days": 0, "action": "order immediately"}],
  "upcoming_items": [{"name": "", "current_stock": 0, "reorder_qty": 0, "order_by_date": ""}],
  "total_reorder_items": 0,
  "alert_summary": "2-3 sentence summary"
}

parameters.subject: =⚠️ Inventory Alert — {{ $json.total_reorder_items }} items need attention
parameters.html:
=

Inventory Alert

{{ $json.alert_summary }}

Critical — Order Immediately

    {{ $json.critical_items.map(i=>`
  • ${i.name}: ${i.current_stock} left, order ${i.reorder_qty} units (stockout in ${i.stockout_in_days} days)

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - WooCommerce Inventory Alert
Runs daily at 7 AM.
Fetches all products + last 30 days sales from WooCommerce API.
Calculates daily sales velocity per product.
Alerts when stock falls below threshold OR will run out before reorder arrives.
GPT-4o calculates exact reorder quantities.
Email + Slack alert only when items need attention.
